scope: Complete descriptive application of one primary-table reverse parser to native H fallback-retained tokens; partial notation output with opaque unmatched symbols, no Reddy comparison or glyph/translation claim
direction: Eva right column to Currier left column
match_policy: At each source offset choose the longest matching right-column string; emit its left-column code once without rescanning output
unmatched_policy: Copy one unmatched original codepoint opaquely and flag its original token-local offset; never discard or replace with asterisk
measures: Full source records/empty counts and input/output vector hashes
All original/partial-output notation character frequencies and lengths
Every rule-use count by physical definition line
Every unmatched event by H ordinal/local token index/source offset/codepoint
Complete token-type bijection and decoder check on all tokens
Within-record and flattened joining A/B counts, with empty H ordinals retained
prior_exposure: Full H source, accepted inventory/parsing, all approximate assays, pending H/Reddy envelope and type reports, current primary definition and synthetic string limits exposed; no untouched evaluation
